jobs.text: This mountain is taller than eight Burj Kha-lee-fas.
Legend says, Hanu-maan flew it, all the way to Lanka.
In Vaalmeeki's Raamaayan, Lakshman is struck down, in the war at Lanka.
The cure? Herbs, from a mountain in the Himalayas.
Tradition says that mountain is Drona giri, in Chamolee, Utta-raa-khand.
Today it stands seven thousand and sixty-six metres tall.
Hanu-maan can't tell which herb is which. So he lifts, the whole peak.
The epic says he grew as big as a mountain.
Even just the top one kilometre would weigh about two point eight billion tonnes.
That's heavier than every human on Earth. Five times over.
[sigh] And I get tired, carrying two grocery bags up the stairs.
Then he flies it about two thousand three hundred kilometres to Lanka.
Give him ten hours. That's two hundred and thirty kilometres an hour. Faster than any train in India.
[dissatisfaction-hnn] Meanwhile, my food delivery takes forty minutes, from two kilometres away.
And in Drona giri village, many still don't worship Hanu-maan.
They believe he took away their sacred mountain.
Follow for more legends, at real scale.
